description: This file contains test cases written using pytest to validate the fallback behavior of the 'acompletion' and 'completion' functions in the 'litellm' module. The tests cover scenarios such as timeout handling, fallback model lists, configuration through dictionaries, and responses when fallbacks return None.

methods.name: test_acompletion_fallbacks_basic()
methods.description: Tests that the acompletion function returns a response when given a valid fallback model list.

methods.name: test_acompletion_fallbacks_bad_models()
methods.description: Verifies that the acompletion call times out or fails gracefully when models are unknown.

methods.name: test_acompletion_fallbacks_with_dict_config()
methods.description: Checks fallback behavior when using a dictionary configuration with API key overrides.

methods.name: test_acompletion_fallbacks_empty_list()
methods.description: Confirms that providing an empty fallback list raises a NotFoundError.

methods.name: test_acompletion_fallbacks_none_response()
methods.description: Ensures that the function continues fallback attempts if a model returns None.

methods.name: test_completion_fallbacks_sync()
methods.description: Tests fallback behavior of the synchronous 'completion' method in 'litellm'.
